ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.

2. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   C. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Hiding stolen items

6. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   D. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   B. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   C. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

11. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

12. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.
   B. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   B. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.
   C. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain The Treaty of Hudaibiya and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain The Conquest of Makkah Hunayn and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Farewell Pilgrimage 03 Total Number of Lessons 90 Page 12 of 73 1 1.0 QUR’AN and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Farewell Pilgrimage Sermon and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Selected Surah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Hadith on Purity of Actions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
